name: Barbarian (2024)
description: Barbarians are mighty warriors powered by primal forces manifesting as Rage, fueling battle prowess, uncanny reflexes, and heightened senses.
starting_equipment_options: (A) Greataxe, 4 Handaxes, Explorer’s Pack, and 15 GP

1.name: Rage
1.description: As a Bonus Action (if not wearing Heavy armor), enter a Rage. Benefits: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing damage; Bonus Rage Damage on Str-based attacks; Advantage on Str checks & saves; Can_t concentrate or cast spells. Duration: Ends end of next turn, extends by attacking, forcing save, or Bonus Action to extend (max 10 min). Uses per Long Rest (regain 1 on Short Rest): 2 (L1), 3 (L4), 4 (L6), 5 (L12), 6 (L17).

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + Dex mod + Con mod. Can use a Shield.

1.name: Weapon Mastery (Level 1)
1.description: Use mastery properties of 2 kinds of Simple/Martial Melee weapons. Change one on Long Rest. (Weapon Mastery column in table: L1=2, L4=2, L10=3, L16=4).

2.name: Danger Sense
2.description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws if not Incapacitated.

2.name: Reckless Attack
2.description: On first Str-based attack roll on turn, can attack recklessly for Advantage on Str-based attack rolls this turn; attack rolls against you have Advantage until your next turn.

3.name: Barbarian Subclass
3.description: Gain a Barbarian subclass. (Path of the Berserker detailed in Basic Rules).

3.name: Primal Knowledge
3.description: Gain proficiency in another skill from Barbarian list. While Raging, can use Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice when taking Attack action.

5.name: Fast Movement
5.description: Speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing Heavy armor.

7.name: Instinctive Pounce
7.description: As part of Bonus Action to enter Rage, can move up to half your Speed.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

9.name: Brutal Strike
9.description: If using Reckless Attack, can forgo Advantage on one Str-based attack. If hits, target takes extra 1d10 damage (weapon type) and choose effect: Forceful Blow (push 15ft, can move half speed towards target) or Hamstring Blow (target speed -15ft until your next turn).

11.name: Relentless Rage
11.description: If drop to 0 HP while Raging (not killed outright), make Con save (DC 10, +5 each use after first, resets on rest) to drop to HP = 2x Barbarian level instead.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

13.name: Improved Brutal Strike (Level 13)
13.description: New Brutal Strike options: Staggering Blow (target has Disadvantage on next save, no Opportunity Attacks until your next turn), Sundering Blow (next attack roll by another creature against target gets +5 bonus).

15.name: Persistent Rage
15.description: When rolling Initiative, can regain all expended uses of Rage (once per Long Rest). Rage now lasts 10 minutes without needing to extend it; ends if Unconscious or don Heavy Armor.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

17.name: Improved Brutal Strike (Level 17)
17.description: Brutal Strike extra damage increases to 2d10. Can use two different Brutal Strike effects.

18.name: Indomitable Might
18.description: If total for Str check or save is less than Str score, can use Str score instead.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of Irresistible Offense recommended).

20.name: Primal Champion
20.description: Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4 (max 25).

source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Barbarian Class
